The protests follow incidents involving **Abhishek Banerjee** and **Kalyan Banerjee**.  The **TMC** plans statewide demonstrations on June 1st at ward, anchal, and block levels.  Following the alleged attacks on **Abhishek Banerjee**, who was assaulted in Sonarpur, West Bengal Police arrested five individuals for heckling him. The **TMC** has condemned these incidents as attempts to suppress dissenting voices and promote violence.

recent_articles.title: Rio’s Forever War | Crime | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Brazil's** police conducted a massive raid on two favelas in Rio de Janeiro on October 28, 2025, targeting leaders of the Red Command drug trafficking group. The operation resulted in over 120 deaths, with bodies left behind and forensic evidence compromised. **Fault Lines** reports that the case of Douglas de Almeida da Silva, a father shot by police during the raid, raises questions about the officers' account and the broader pattern of police misconduct in Rio.  The raid highlights ongoing challenges in controlling violence within favelas despite repeated operations.

recent_articles.title: Four-time champion Swiatek out as French Open continues to deliver shocks | Tennis | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Iga Swiatek**, the four-time French Open champion, was defeated by **Marta Kostyuk** in straight sets in the round of 16.  This follows a string of shock exits at this year's tournament, including those of **Coco Gauff**, **Jannik Sinner**, and **Novak Djokovic**. **Aryna Sabalenka** is now the favorite to win the title, while **Elina Svitolina** or **Belinda Bencic** await **Kostyuk** in the next round.  The tournament has seen several upsets, with **Sorana Cirstea** reaching her first Roland Garros quarterfinal in 17 years.
